message:
Manager, Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer, Solar Energy Systems Engineer and Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist, the box feet carry only box weight on their own path.

In plain words a small car on six feet is safe on soft field soil, while the distant solar field goes to its own feet and is not counted twice. Reusing the complete superstructure mass sum (E118) at 2210 kg naming produce plus crates plus racking plus panels plus door plus battery plus eutectic plus monoblock plus roof gantry plus ground frame plus wiring, separated to the chamber-only mass sum (E126) at 1930 kg excluding the seven-module ground frame, giving the chamber-only pad pressure (E127) at 23.2 kPa and 28.5 kPa with foundation self-weight, which supersedes 19.8 kPa and stays below 150 kPa soil from the Structural Design Calculation Sheet source (E62), about one person standing at 20 to 30 kPa so everyday scale holds.

Cold-Chain Refrigeration Engineer, your cold leak uses the same skin I weigh, so no double count.

In plain words thick foam that weighs little buys small heat leak. Reusing interior 8.64 cubic metres from the interior volume estimate (E39) with envelope 25.4 square metres from the envelope area square metres (E40) giving conduction 203 W from the conduction watts at 43C ambient 5C room (E41), I confirm from my discipline the rule in the Insulated PUR PIR Sandwich Panel 100mm Cold Room Panels Roof Cladding source (E116) at 12.1 kg per square metre gives about 306 kg on that same 25.4 square metre envelope for Polyisocyanurate (PIR, rigid foam insulation) weight already inside the complete mass, buying U about 0.21 W per square metre Kelvin and that 203 W leak, about two old light bulbs so everyday scale holds.

Solar Energy Systems Engineer and Smallholder Cooperative Operations Specialist, distant frames are tied down on their own feet and soft curtains are clamped to hard foam so wind and air do not break holding.

In plain words sunshade plus field panels cannot push on foam, uplift like nine adults is held with factor two, and the one-crate door plus pipes close tight. Photovoltaic (PV, solar electricity) stays 2 modules on roof gantry with vent gap plus 7 on separate ground frame for 17.6 square metres from the nine-module footprint for grown array (E84), with wind 375 Pa giving 673 kg uplift mass equivalent held by 1390 kg from eight screw anchors at 1.7 kN pull-out each on soft soil basis from the ground screw anchor source, and I jointly confirm with you the Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC, flexible plastic) strip curtain clamped to rigid PIR plus gasket plus flashing at the rear evaporator penetration plus trapped condensate drain to outside bucket tied to the dimensioned crate layout sketch (E124), which the 900 mm standard door from the Coolroom Buying Guide: Walk-In Refrigeration for Kitchens source (E71) needs to keep the single door model 8 curtain openings sensible plus latent (E110) at 0.169 kWh per day true.

My position is ready on version three, because complete-to-separated mass, consistent envelope, quantified uplift hold and sealed soft-to-rigid transitions now close except field pull and 43 degree pull-down bench tests needing built hardware.
